The '''Redrish system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==Description==
The Redrish system served as one of two main staging areas for [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]] heading to the [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. This [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located 16 [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] away from the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>
